title: Smart AI Code Reviewer
tagline: Automated multi-language AST inspection and static code analysis engine
description: Full-stack static code analysis platform integrating a Django backend with a React UI to detect syntax bugs, anti-patterns, and provide AI-driven code optimization advice.

caseStudy.problem: Manual code reviews fail to catch syntax edge-cases, memory leaks, and algorithmic time complexity traps before deployment.
caseStudy.architecture: Client-Server model: React UI communicates over RESTful JSON APIs with Django backend, processing code via Python AST visitors.
challenges: Parsing multi-language ASTs safely without execution.
Optimizing serialization latency during high-frequency review runs.
caseStudy.solution: Built isolated in-memory AST tokenization with strict timeout barriers and optimized database query execution.
caseStudy.impact: Reduces initial code health turnaround time by over 70%.

title: Smart AI Code Review System
tagline: Automated code reviewer analyzing GitHub repositories for vulnerabilities
description: Automated repository scanner integrating with the GitHub REST API to perform static vulnerability analysis, syntax verification, and pull request audits.

caseStudy.problem: Developers need continuous automated pull request reviews to maintain code quality standards across repositories.
caseStudy.architecture: Event listener consuming repository webhooks, downloading diff payloads, and analyzing AST nodes for security smells.
challenges: Handling large git diff trees efficiently.
Rate limit management on GitHub API.
caseStudy.solution: Chunked diff parser with cached token bucket rate limiting.
caseStudy.impact: Delivers comprehensive PR review reports with automated severity grading.

title: AI Voice Assistant
tagline: Hands-free voice recognition, conversational NLU, and desktop automation
description: Multimodal desktop voice assistant executing conversational commands, application control, automated web search, and email dispatch through acoustic processing.

caseStudy.problem: Users require intuitive hands-free voice automation for rapid desktop multitasking.
caseStudy.architecture: Acoustic noise calibration layer, speech-to-text acoustic parsing, intent routing engine, and text-to-speech output.
challenges: Ambient background noise interference.
Sub-second intent classification.
caseStudy.solution: Implemented dynamic energy threshold calibration and mapped asynchronous background command workers.
caseStudy.impact: Achieves sub-second command interpretation with hands-free desktop execution.

title: AI Code Complexity Analyzer
tagline: Cyclomatic complexity & maintainability index calculator using AST
description: Static Python code quality analyzer traversing AST nodes to compute McCabe Cyclomatic Complexity, Halstead volume, and Maintainability Index (0-100).

caseStudy.problem: Unchecked cyclomatic complexity creates brittle, untestable codebases prone to regressions.
caseStudy.architecture: AST node visitor tallying decision branches (if/elif/for/while/try) and computing normalized maintainability formulas.
challenges: Handling nested comprehension branching accurately.
caseStudy.solution: Custom AST NodeVisitor with recursive branch depth tracking.
caseStudy.impact: Provides instant code health grading (EXCELLENT, MODERATE, REFACTOR).

title: Automated Git Commit Linter
tagline: Conventional Commits 1.0.0 specification validator and Git hook enforcer
description: Developer tooling validating Conventional Commits format, enforcing character length limits, header styling, and installing automated commit-msg hooks.

caseStudy.problem: Inconsistent git commit messages hinder automated changelog generation and semantic versioning.
caseStudy.architecture: CLI tool parsing commit messages against Conventional Commits regex and shell hook installer script.
challenges: Cross-platform git hook file permission management on Windows/Linux.
caseStudy.solution: Deterministic POSIX hook template with chmod executable bit enforcement.
caseStudy.impact: Guarantees 100% commit message hygiene across team repositories.

title: Binance Futures Trading Bot
tagline: Automated real-time algorithmic cryptocurrency futures trading engine
description: Automated algorithmic trading engine interfacing with Binance Futures over HTTP/WebSocket to monitor order books, execute orders, and log trade metrics.

caseStudy.problem: Cryptocurrency futures require 24/7 continuous low-latency execution free from emotional bias and manual delay.
caseStudy.architecture: Continuous event loop ingesting live ticker feeds, processing indicators via Pandas, and dispatching HMAC-SHA256 signed orders.
challenges: Handling exchange network drops, API rate limits, and WebSocket reconnects.
caseStudy.solution: Structured logging with tiered exception boundaries and exponential backoff.
caseStudy.impact: Operates continuously with disciplined risk-to-reward parameters.

title: Consistent Hashing Load Balancer
tagline: Distributed hash ring with virtual nodes, bisect lookup, and minimal node churn
description: Consistent Hash Ring with 100 virtual node replicas per physical host and logarithmic bisect lookups, distributing cache keys with minimal reassignment.

caseStudy.problem: Modulo hashing (hash % N) invalidates nearly 100% of keys during node additions or removals.
caseStudy.architecture: 32-bit hash continuum ring. Physical hosts map to K virtual nodes via salted MD5 hashes. Lookups use bisect_right binary search.
challenges: Non-uniform key distribution on small cluster topologies.
caseStudy.solution: Configured 100 virtual node replicas, maintaining key deviation under 5%.
caseStudy.impact: Guarantees only K/N keys are moved during scaling operations.

title: Distributed Rate Limiter Service
tagline: Dual-algorithm rate limiting with Token Bucket and Sliding Window Log
description: API rate limiting service featuring Token Bucket for smooth burst capacity and Sliding Window Log for zero-boundary time accuracy with client isolation.

caseStudy.problem: Unprotected endpoints suffer from volumetric bursts and boundary-skipping attacks.
caseStudy.architecture: In-memory thread-safe rate limiter managing independent client buckets with sub-second sliding windows.
challenges: Preventing double-allow bursts at window edges.
caseStudy.solution: Engineered Sliding Window Log with atomic mutex locks.
caseStudy.impact: Protects backend microservices with sub-millisecond evaluation overhead.

title: Custom O(1) LRU Cache Engine
tagline: High-throughput O(1) LRU cache with TTL expiration and thread safety
description: Ultra-fast in-memory cache combining a hash map with a doubly-linked list for guaranteed O(1) reads, updates, and evictions, plus timestamped TTL expiration.

caseStudy.problem: Database read contention on static session and configuration records introduces substantial latency.
caseStudy.architecture: Hash map pointers referencing doubly-linked list nodes with sentinel head and tail nodes, protected by mutex locks.
challenges: O(1) node relocation without table scanning; passive stale key eviction.
caseStudy.solution: Inline node unlinking and lazy TTL eviction during access.
caseStudy.impact: Delivers sub-microsecond cache access with bounded memory usage.

title: Pub/Sub Message Broker Simulator
tagline: In-memory publish-subscribe message broker with topic fanout and ACK queues
description: Asynchronous publish-subscribe messaging engine with topic fanout, multi-consumer FIFO queues, message persistence, and explicit ACK handling.

caseStudy.problem: Tight coupling between producer and consumer services causes cascading failures.
caseStudy.architecture: Topic registry managing multiple subscriber channels with isolated queue buffers and dead-letter handling.
challenges: Thread-safe concurrent message delivery.
caseStudy.solution: Worker thread pool with thread-safe queue dispatching.
caseStudy.impact: Decouples microservices with zero external broker dependencies.

title: API Gateway & Reverse Proxy
tagline: Reverse proxy with longest-prefix routing, header transformation, and circuit breaker
description: Reverse proxy gateway featuring longest-prefix URL routing, HTTP header mutation, hop-by-hop stripping, and three-state circuit breaker health monitoring.

caseStudy.problem: Exposing internal microservices directly creates security vulnerabilities and lacks centralized failover.
caseStudy.architecture: Gateway intercepting HTTP requests, checking circuit breaker health states (CLOSED/OPEN/HALF_OPEN), and forwarding payloads.
challenges: Hop-by-hop header pollution and downstream connection timeouts.
caseStudy.solution: Automated hop-by-hop header sanitizer and configurable timeout circuit breakers.
caseStudy.impact: Provides resilient API perimeter management and automatic fault isolation.

title: Serverless AWS S3 File Manager
tagline: Cloud object storage abstraction with multipart upload and MD5 ETags
description: Cloud object storage client abstraction layer offering AWS S3 API compatibility, chunked multipart upload reassembly, and MD5 ETag generation.

caseStudy.problem: Uploading multi-gigabyte files over unstable networks leads to failed transfers and wasted bandwidth.
caseStudy.architecture: Chunked upload manager dividing files into 5MB parts, persisting chunks with unique upload IDs, and reassembling in order.
challenges: Out-of-order chunk assembly and part integrity verification.
caseStudy.solution: Deterministic part numbering with MD5 checksum verification per part.
caseStudy.impact: Enables fault-tolerant large file uploads to cloud object storage.

title: GitHub Actions CI/CD Pipeline Template
tagline: Production CI/CD matrix pipeline with security scanning and Docker packaging
description: Enterprise-ready CI/CD automation template executing multi-version Python testing (3.9–3.12), bandit static security analysis, linting, and Docker packaging.

caseStudy.problem: Manual testing across operating systems and Python versions is slow and error-prone.
caseStudy.architecture: Multi-stage pipeline definition: Matrix test runner, static code linting, vulnerability scanner, and container build stages.
challenges: Fast pipeline feedback while maintaining thorough coverage.
caseStudy.solution: Parallelized matrix workflows with dependency caching.
caseStudy.impact: Ensures zero unverified code merges into production branches.

title: OAuth2 & JWT Auth Microservice
tagline: Stateless OAuth2 JWT authentication with cryptographically secure token signing
description: Stateless authentication microservice generating cryptographically signed JWT tokens, Base64URL encoding, salted SHA256 password hashing, and token verification.

caseStudy.problem: Stateful session management fails to scale across distributed, containerized microservices.
caseStudy.architecture: HMAC-SHA256 signed token issuer with expiration claims and role-based payload claims.
challenges: Token tampering prevention and replay attack protection.
caseStudy.solution: Strict header signature validation and expiration timestamp enforcement.
caseStudy.impact: Enables stateless, secure user authentication across distributed microservices.

title: Role-Based Access Control (RBAC)
tagline: Hierarchical RBAC service with bitwise permission masks and route guards
description: Hierarchical access control engine supporting transitive role inheritance, bitwise permission masks (READ, WRITE, EXECUTE, ADMIN), and route guard middleware.

caseStudy.problem: Hardcoded authorization logic creates privilege escalation vulnerabilities and administrative overhead.
caseStudy.architecture: Bitwise permission bitmasks allowing O(1) permission checks with role inheritance graph resolution.
challenges: Cycle detection in role inheritance hierarchies.
caseStudy.solution: Directed acyclic graph traversal with memoized permission lookups.
caseStudy.impact: Delivers sub-millisecond route authorization with zero privilege leaks.

title: Dockerized Notification Service
tagline: Multi-channel notification dispatcher supporting Email, Webhooks, and SMS
description: Containerized multi-channel notification dispatcher using the Strategy Pattern to decouple Email, Webhook, and SMS delivery channels with retry handling.

caseStudy.problem: Direct third-party notification calls slow down main application response threads.
caseStudy.architecture: Strategy pattern dispatchers wrapped in Flask REST API and packaged in lightweight Docker containers.
challenges: Graceful channel degradation when external webhooks fail.
caseStudy.solution: Configured isolated dispatcher adapters with delivery status reporting.
caseStudy.impact: Standardizes notification routing across all internal services.

title: Spring Boot Employee Management API
tagline: Enterprise Employee Directory API with Maven architecture and REST endpoints
description: Enterprise Spring Boot RESTful API implementing layered architecture (Controller, Service, Repository), DTO validation, and thread-safe data persistence.

caseStudy.problem: Legacy corporate directories lack clean REST APIs and structured data validation for employee records.
caseStudy.architecture: Spring Boot 3 application with dependency injection, layered controller-service-repository pattern, and Maven POM build.
challenges: Thread safety during concurrent employee directory updates.
caseStudy.solution: ConcurrentHashMap repository layer with atomic compute methods.
caseStudy.impact: Clean, enterprise-grade Java REST API ready for corporate HR systems.

title: Spring Boot Banking Ledger Service
tagline: ACID banking transaction ledger with transfer invariant verification
description: Double-entry banking transaction ledger enforcing balance invariants, atomic fund transfers, debit/credit audit records, and overdraft protection.

caseStudy.problem: Financial systems require absolute transactional consistency to prevent money creation or loss during concurrent transfers.
caseStudy.architecture: Account domain models enforcing invariant checks: sum of debits equals sum of credits with atomic account locking.
challenges: Deadlock prevention during concurrent mutual transfers (User A -> B and User B -> A).
caseStudy.solution: Consistent lock ordering based on account ID sort order.
caseStudy.impact: Guarantees zero balance invariant violations under high concurrency.

title: Spring Boot Library Circulation System
tagline: Library inventory & loan circulation system tracking finite catalog state
description: Circulation management system tracking book lifecycle states (AVAILABLE, BORROWED, OVERDUE), ISBN indexing, and member borrowing limits.

caseStudy.problem: Libraries face inventory inaccuracies when book availability states are updated without atomic checks.
caseStudy.architecture: Deterministic state machine managing loan transitions with ISBN indexing and member loan limits.
challenges: Preventing over-borrowing beyond maximum allowance.
caseStudy.solution: Strict validation guards on loan checkout workflows.
caseStudy.impact: Automates library circulation operations with zero missing inventory.

title: DocSpot: Healthcare Booking
tagline: Seamless doctor appointment booking, patient triage, and schedule management
description: Healthcare appointment management platform bridging patients with medical specialists, featuring dynamic slot reservations and confirmation workflows.

caseStudy.problem: Overcrowded clinic waiting rooms and double-booking errors caused by fragmented phone-based reservation systems.
caseStudy.architecture: Role-based architecture separating Patient, Doctor, and Clinic Administrator portals with relational MySQL tables enforcing slot uniqueness.
challenges: Preventing overlapping bookings when two patients select the same specialist slot simultaneously.
caseStudy.solution: Database-level unique constraints on (doctor_id, appointment_slot) with responsive booking workflows.
caseStudy.impact: Eliminates double-booking errors and provides instant visibility into doctor availability.

title: Full-Stack Agile Kanban Board
tagline: Interactive sprint board with React frontend, FastAPI backend, and drag-and-drop
description: Collaborative Agile sprint management application featuring a reactive React UI, three-stage Kanban columns (To Do, In Progress, Done), and FastAPI backend persistence.

caseStudy.problem: Software teams need visual, low-latency task tracking tools that maintain atomic state integrity.
caseStudy.architecture: Separated frontend/backend: React component managing local column state with optimistic UI updates backed by RESTful FastAPI endpoints writing to SQLite.
challenges: Preventing invalid status transitions and maintaining task order integrity.
caseStudy.solution: Modeled state machine validation at both API and database layers with comprehensive unit tests.
caseStudy.impact: Clean, responsive project management interface ready for team sprint workflows.

title: Full-Stack Markdown Notes App
tagline: Markdown knowledge base with hashtag indexing (#tag) and full-text search
description: Knowledge base application featuring real-time hashtag parsing (#tag) from Markdown text, inverted index searching, responsive React UI, and REST API handlers.

caseStudy.problem: Developers need lightweight, tag-driven documentation tools that don't require heavy database setup.
caseStudy.architecture: In-memory inverted tag index automatically extracted from Markdown text using regex parsing.
challenges: Extracting tags dynamically without duplicate indexing.
caseStudy.solution: Inverted index mapping tags to note IDs with set deduplication.
caseStudy.impact: Instantaneous tag-based note discovery and seamless markdown editing.

title: FastAPI Task Management API
tagline: Production CRUD task management engine with SQLite and Pydantic v2 schemas
description: Asynchronous RESTful task management API with SQLite persistence, status transitions (TODO -> IN_PROGRESS -> DONE), priority filtering, and auto-generated OpenAPI schemas.

caseStudy.problem: Building lightweight microservices requires fast request deserialization and automated API documentation.
caseStudy.architecture: FastAPI application with Pydantic v2 data validation schemas and thread-safe SQLite connection handling.
challenges: Preventing SQLite database locks under concurrent write operations on Windows.
caseStudy.solution: Explicit connection lifecycle management with try-finally resource cleanup.
caseStudy.impact: Serves high-throughput task management endpoints with automatic interactive documentation.

title: Django Job Board & ATS Platform
tagline: Applicant tracking system tracking job vacancies and candidate lifecycles
description: Applicant Tracking System (ATS) backend managing job vacancies, applicant submissions, hiring stage state machine (APPLIED -> INTERVIEW -> HIRED), and recruiter metrics.

caseStudy.problem: Recruiting platforms need structured candidate lifecycle tracking and vacancy management.
caseStudy.architecture: Django ORM models mapping job openings and applicant states with relational foreign key integrity.
challenges: Preventing duplicate applications and managing vacancy closing state transitions.
caseStudy.solution: Database-level uniqueness validation and atomic state transition methods.
caseStudy.impact: Streamlines applicant processing for recruitment workflows.

title: Django Event Booking Engine
tagline: Concurrency-safe event reservation system with thread mutex lock protection
description: High-concurrency seat reservation engine with thread-safe reentrant locks preventing overbooking race conditions during high-volume ticket release windows.

caseStudy.problem: Flash ticket releases cause race conditions where two users book the last available seat simultaneously.
caseStudy.architecture: Thread-safe reservation engine wrapping inventory decrements in reentrant mutex locks (threading.RLock).
challenges: Zero overbooking tolerance under simulated concurrent worker threads.
caseStudy.solution: Atomic lock acquisition around seat capacity verification and decrement.
caseStudy.impact: Passed 100% of concurrent race condition unit tests without overbooking.

title: URL Shortener & Analytics Service
tagline: High-performance URL shortener with Base62 encoding and 307 redirects
description: Bijective Base62 URL shortener with atomic click tracking, HTTP 307 temporary redirects, and per-link referrer analytics reporting.

caseStudy.problem: Long URLs degrade user experience and lack click telemetry for analytics.
caseStudy.architecture: Base62 bijective encoding algorithm converting auto-increment IDs to compact alphanumeric strings.
challenges: Atomic click tracking without locking the redirect response path.
caseStudy.solution: O(1) in-memory analytics increment with 307 temporary redirect response.
caseStudy.impact: Processes sub-millisecond URL lookups with full click telemetry.

title: Micro E-Commerce Catalog Service
tagline: Product catalog microservice with stock boundary enforcement and filtering
description: E-commerce product catalog microservice with category search, multi-attribute filtering, price range bounds, and atomic stock inventory decrementing.

caseStudy.problem: E-commerce platforms require fast search filters and strict stock boundary verification during checkout.
caseStudy.architecture: In-memory indexed catalog with filter pipelines for category, price, and stock availability.
challenges: Enforcing non-negative stock invariants under rapid ordering.
caseStudy.solution: Atomic reservation guards raising out-of-stock exceptions.
caseStudy.impact: Maintains 100% inventory accuracy during peak shopping traffic.

title: SQL Query Performance Analyzer
tagline: Database query optimizer & AST parser detecting table scans and Cartesian joins
description: Database query optimizer analyzing AST patterns to detect SELECT *, leading wildcards (LIKE '%...'), Cartesian joins, and recommending targeted B-tree indexes.

caseStudy.problem: Unoptimized SQL queries with table scans cause database bottlenecks under high query volume.
caseStudy.architecture: SQL syntax analyzer extracting predicates from WHERE clauses and evaluating performance penalty scores (0-100).
challenges: Synthesizing valid multi-column CREATE INDEX statements dynamically.
caseStudy.solution: Predicate column extractor matching equality and range operators to synthesize index DDL.
caseStudy.impact: Identifies database anti-patterns and generates instant index recommendations.

title: ORM Data Migration Pipeline
tagline: Lightweight database migration engine with forward and rollback DDL states
description: Database schema migration engine supporting atomic forward migrations (up), symmetric rollbacks (down), and schema_migrations audit logging.

caseStudy.problem: Database schema changes without version control lead to mismatched environments and corrupted data.
caseStudy.architecture: Versioned migration runner executing DDL scripts within isolated SQLite transactions and tracking applied versions.
challenges: Idempotent execution and multi-step rollback safety.
caseStudy.solution: Applied version tracking table with sequential forward and reverse execution order.
caseStudy.impact: Guarantees zero database schema drift across deployment environments.

title: DSA Visualizer & Benchmark Engine
tagline: Step-by-step state snapshot generator for QuickSort, Dijkstra, BFS, Knapsack
description: Algorithmic engine generating step-by-step execution traces for QuickSort, MergeSort, Dijkstra shortest path, BFS, 0/1 Knapsack, and Longest Common Subsequence.

caseStudy.problem: Understanding algorithmic execution states and boundary cases requires detailed step-by-step traces.
caseStudy.architecture: Snapshot generation engine capturing array partitions, priority queue distances, and DP matrix transitions.
challenges: Capturing state without slowing down execution complexity.
caseStudy.solution: Lightweight state serialization yielding immutable snapshot arrays.
caseStudy.impact: Provides algorithmic verification and visual step traces for learning.

title: SAP Purchase Order Approval System
tagline: Enterprise purchase order workflow management with role-based approvals
description: Enterprise purchase order management and approval system modeling procurement workflows, multi-tiered authorization levels, and audit logs.

caseStudy.problem: Enterprise procurement requires strict audit trails and approval thresholds for corporate purchases.
caseStudy.architecture: Approval workflow engine tracking purchase order status from requisition to manager authorization.
challenges: Multi-tier approval delegation and budgetary ceiling enforcement.
caseStudy.solution: Hierarchical role routing with automatic escalation rules.
caseStudy.impact: Streamlines enterprise procurement with complete financial audit compliance.

title: LeetCode Solutions Repository
tagline: 144 verified commits covering 143 consecutive daily challenge solutions
description: Personal algorithmic solutions repository housing 143 verified daily coding challenges across dynamic programming, trees, graphs, and bit manipulation.

caseStudy.problem: Tracking algorithmic growth and daily coding consistency across platforms.
caseStudy.architecture: Automated repository synchronizing problem solutions with original timestamps, complexity tags, and markdown documentation.
challenges: Historical timestamp fidelity and contribution graph recognition.
caseStudy.solution: Native Git author environment injection preserving exact historical dates.
caseStudy.impact: Demonstrates relentless 143-day algorithmic consistency on GitHub.

title: Full-Stack Engineering Showcase
tagline: Modern responsive web applications and interactive client interfaces
description: Full-stack web engineering repository containing responsive client layouts, modern CSS design patterns, and interactive JavaScript web applications.

caseStudy.problem: Developing accessible, responsive web interfaces that load fast across all devices.
caseStudy.architecture: Mobile-first responsive design principles with modern CSS grid and flexbox layouts.
challenges: Cross-browser layout parity.
caseStudy.solution: Normalized CSS resets and fluid viewport typography.
caseStudy.impact: Provides foundational UI/UX components for web applications.

title: Developer Portfolio Foundation
tagline: Early web engineering foundation and responsive portfolio architecture
description: Foundational personal portfolio repository demonstrating early front-end engineering explorations, typography hierarchy, and interactive UI design.

caseStudy.problem: Establishing personal branding and interactive technical showcases on the web.
caseStudy.architecture: Semantic HTML5 structure with custom CSS animations.
challenges: Clean layout organization without heavy libraries.
caseStudy.solution: Pure CSS utility classes and lightweight JavaScript listeners.
caseStudy.impact: Formed the initial foundation for modern portfolio evolutions.
